rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose way to say that someone or something cannot be mistaken for anything else.

example.english: This logo is so distinctive that it is unmistakable.
example.traditional: 呢個標誌咁特別，真係唔會認錯。
example.jyutping: ne1 go3 biu1 zi3 gam3 dak6 bit6 zan1 hai6 m4 wui5 jing6 co3

rows.jyutping: jat1 ngaan5 zau6 jing6 dak1 ceot1
rows.note: Use this when the person or thing is immediately recognizable by sight.

example.english: Wearing that red coat, you are unmistakable to me.
example.traditional: 你着住嗰件紅色外套，我一眼就認得出。
example.jyutping: nei5 zoek3 zyu6 go2 gin6 hung4 sik1 ngoi6 tou3 ngo5 jat1 ngaan5 zau6 jing6 dak1 ceot1

rows.jyutping: jat1 teng1 zau6 jing6 dak1 ceot1
rows.note: Use this when a voice, sound, or piece of music is immediately recognizable by hearing.

example.english: Their voice is so distinctive that it is unmistakable as soon as I hear it.
example.traditional: 佢把聲咁特別，我一聽就認得出。
example.jyutping: keoi5 baa2 seng1 gam3 dak6 bit6 ngo5 jat1 teng1 zau6 jing6 dak1 ceot1
